description: Build Live Match Center page integrating all components. Create LiveMatchCenter.tsx page component. Implement live event timeline, live statistics display, and lineup components. Integrate LivePitch component. Add 30-second polling for live updates. Create navigation from live matches list. Add Turkish UI labels. Style with dark theme consistent with TUTAR X design.
steps: Read frontend/src/App.tsx to understand routing pattern and existing pages
Read frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx to understand page structure and styling patterns
Read investigation report section 9 'User Interface Labels (Turkish)' for correct Turkish translations
Create frontend/src/pages/LiveMatchCenter.tsx: Functional React component with useParams to get matchId from route
Import getLiveMatchDetail, getLiveEvents, getLiveLineups, getLiveStatistics from frontend/src/api/client.ts
Implement useState hooks: liveState (LiveMatchState | null), events (LiveEvent[]), lineups (LiveLineups | null), stats (LiveStatistics | null), loading (boolean), error (string | null)
Implement useEffect for initial data fetch: On mount, call all 4 API functions, update state, handle errors
Implement useEffect for polling: setInterval every 30 seconds, call getLiveMatchDetail, update liveState only if status is 'LIVE', clearInterval on unmount or when status becomes 'FINISHED'
Render page header: 'CANLI MAÇ MERKEZİ' title, match info (home team vs away team, competition, date/time)
Render live score section: homeScore - awayScore, current minute display ('DAKİKA: {minute}'), match status badge (LIVE = red pulsing, HALF_TIME = orange, FINISHED = gray)

Create frontend/src/components/live/LiveEventTimeline.tsx: Accept events prop (LiveEvent[]), render chronological list (newest first), display event type icon (⚽ GOAL, 🟨 YELLOW_CARD, 🟥 RED_CARD, 🔄 SUBSTITUTION), minute, player name, team indicator

Create frontend/src/components/live/LiveStatistics.tsx: Accept homeStats and awayStats props (LiveStats), render horizontal bars for possession %, shots comparison, corners, fouls, cards, display '—' for unavailable stats (undefined values)

Create frontend/src/components/live/LiveLineups.tsx: Accept lineups prop (LiveLineups | null), display home and away formations side-by-side, list starting XI with jersey numbers, list substitutes, indicate substitutions with icon
Import LivePitch component, render with homeLineup={lineups?.homeLineup} awayLineup={lineups?.awayLineup}
Integrate all components in LiveMatchCenter: Layout with sections for Score (top), Pitch (center), Events (left), Statistics (right), Lineups (bottom)

Add CSS styling in frontend/src/pages/LiveMatchCenter.css: Dark theme (#1a1a1a background), card-based layout, responsive grid (2 columns on desktop, 1 column on mobile), pulsing animation for LIVE badge
Create frontend/src/pages/LiveMatchesList.tsx: Simple page listing live matches, call getLiveMatches() from existing API client, display as cards with score and minute, link to /live/{matchId}
Update frontend/src/App.tsx: Add routes <Route path='/live' element={<LiveMatchesList />} /> and <Route path='/live/:matchId' element={<LiveMatchCenter />} />
Update navigation in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx (if nav exists) to include 'CANLI' link to /live

Test full flow: Start backend server, start frontend server, navigate to /live, click a live match, verify all components load, verify polling updates score/minute every 30 seconds, verify pitch displays formation, verify events timeline shows events
Update docs/PROGRESS.md: Add entry for Phase 21 completion with verification commands and results
Commit: 'feat(frontend): add Live Match Center page with pitch, events, statistics, and polling'
